title: Policy, plan and tracking
done_when: AGENTS.md has a 'Desktop app slices' paragraph (branch `desk/<slice-id>`, nested workspace, manifests architect-owned, no `macos`/`darwin` in desk file names, the `oxa-review` line). Labels `desk`, `desk-w0`..`desk-w6`, `desk-followup` exist. One tracking issue and one issue per slice exist, created from slices.json.
tests: None (docs and policy). The documentation links check is green.

title: Nested workspace, empty crates and the desk CI job
done_when: A PR that changes only `oxa/desk/**` gets the `desk check` and `desk test` results and no engine/oxa/gateway job. `oxa-desk --version` prints the same line as `oxa --version` (the binary is the oxa shim plus a window). `gate` in checks.yml aggregates the desk job. The job time is written to the job summary.
tests: Classifier cases in test_paths.py: desk-only, desk plus changelog fragment, desk plus shared crate. A CI step runs `oxa-desk --version` and compares it with the workspace version.

title: GPUI pin, lock file, first window, headless smoke, macOS check
done_when: `oxa-desk --desk-smoke` opens a window, draws one frame, prints `desk-first-frame ms=<n>` and exits 0 under a headless Wayland compositor with software Vulkan in CI. `cargo check` is green on a hosted macOS arm64 runner. The lock file was produced by the `lock` dispatch of desk.yml, not by hand. Licences of the new crates are in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.
tests: The headless smoke step. The macOS check job (manifest changes, nightly and dispatch only).

title: Merge-queue fast path for desk-only trees
done_when: A queued group that changes only desk paths (and `changelog.d/desk-*.md`, `oxa/docs/pages/desk/**`) runs the scans, rustfmt, links and the desk job, not the complete oxa workspace. A queued group that changes `oxa/` outside `oxa/desk/` also runs `desk check` (cargo check only), so main cannot break the desktop silently. Queue time per desk PR is recorded before and after in the PR.
tests: Classifier cases for both directions. `gate` refuses a missing `desk` output.

title: Registry: a Desk surface on every declaration
done_when: `Surface::Desk` exists; every declaration states `desk: Supported` or `Exception(reason)`; `entries(Surface::Desk)` lists the supported ones. A `Desk` declaration (`oxa desk`) exists with `cli: Exception("The desktop app is not shipped yet")`.
tests: The registry's own tests cover the new surface the same way they cover Slash and Menu.

title: Front-end seam in oxa-cli (`run_with`)
done_when: `oxa_cli::run_with(argv, env, io, &mut dyn Frontend)` builds the session exactly as `run` does and hands `(Session, InteractiveOpts)` and the trust question to the front end. `run` is `run_with` with the TUI. Two sessions run at the same time in one process against the scripted engine. If that is not possible, the PR names the process-global state that stops it and Z05 ships `InProcess = one session per process`; the desktop then opens further interactive threads as `--mode rpc` children (the store API does not change).
tests: The existing PTY/tmux live checks stay green. A test drives a turn through a non-terminal front end. A test runs two sessions concurrently.

title: Worker loop without a periodic wake
done_when: A front end can ask the worker to block with no 250 ms tick when the attention waker is installed (`WorkerStop::without_idle_tick()` or an options argument). The TUI default is unchanged. An idle session thread makes zero wakeups in ten seconds in the test.
tests: A host request posted while the worker blocks is served through the waker. The TUI idle test is unchanged.

title: Front-end-neutral effects out of the TUI driver
done_when: Saving a setting, saving the permission mode, persisting a theme, renaming and deleting a session, export, the bug report bundle and the trust decision are public functions in `effects.rs` that take plain inputs and return a notice. The TUI driver calls them. No behaviour changes.
tests: The existing d7, d8, d11 and dint tests stay green. One test calls an effect with no terminal.

title: Secret request context and a zeroised answer type
done_when: `Ui::secret_ask(&SecretAsk) -> Option<SecretValue>` exists with a default that calls `secret`. `SecretAsk` carries the prompt, the exact command, the pid and the tool. `SecretValue` zeroises on drop and has no Debug, Display, Clone or Serialize. The broker passes the context it already holds and writes the reply without keeping a second copy. The TUI dialog behaves as before.
tests: The askpass test proves the value reaches the asking process and is absent from records and Debug output. A test proves the buffer is zero after drop.

title: Light session index and one shared thread order
done_when: `FsStore::thread_index(cwd) -> Vec<ThreadMeta>` reads only the header line and a bounded tail of each file (id, path, cwd, parent, relation, name, modified, size). `thread_order(&[ThreadMeta]) -> Vec<(usize, u16)>` gives index and depth; `SessionSort::Threaded` uses the same function. The PR states where worker and subagent sessions record their parent; if they do not, it adds the relation at `SessionStore::create`.
tests: The picker order is unchanged. An index over many sessions reads a bounded number of bytes per file.

title: RPC event decoding
done_when: `event_from_json(&Value) -> Option<AgentEvent>` decodes every record `event_to_json` writes; an unknown type is `None`.
tests: Round trip over the shared fixture events.

title: Shared fixture events for TUI and desktop tests
done_when: `oxa_fake::fixtures` offers named event sequences: chat, tool run with a diff, streaming bash, compaction, retry, error, worker cards, a secret ask. One TUI test renders them through `frames`.
tests: The TUI test; the desktop slices use the same sequences.

title: Descriptors and key ids for the desktop
done_when: Owner settings exist with generous defaults: `oxa.desk.keepTranscripts` (30), `oxa.desk.font`, `oxa.desk.fontSize`, `oxa.desk.blinkCursor` (off). Desk key ids (`desk.palette`, `desk.settings`, `desk.split`, `desk.focus.*`) exist in the keymap. The settings page is regenerated.
tests: The descriptor table's own checks. No count is pinned.

title: desk-core contract types
done_when: Every type and signature of section 1.4 compiles. `ask.rs` and `secret.rs` hold the final public API with a simple body that the owning slice replaces.
tests: A compile-only test names every public item, so a removed item breaks the build.

title: Store shell and module stubs
done_when: `Store::new`, `feeder`, `drain`, `dispatch` and every read accessor exist. `drain` and `dispatch` route to one `apply` function per module; each is a stub in the file its slice owns. No later slice edits `store.rs`, `lib.rs` or a `mod.rs`.
tests: Draining an empty inbox changes nothing and does not wake.

title: GPUI kit
done_when: The kit offers: theme tokens from the oxa theme, styled-span text, a uniform virtual list and a variable-height virtual list, key binding helpers, pane, button, overlay/sheet, and a headless test harness that renders a view to a text tree. Slices use only the kit and the GPUI items the cheat sheet lists.
tests: A kit test renders a 10,000-row list and asserts how many rows were built.

title: Workbench shell, event pump and view stubs
done_when: The window shows the three columns with empty views. `pump.rs` connects the feeder's wake to the foreground executor, drains once per wake and notifies only the views whose `Changed` bits are set. Every view has its final constructor signature. `--desk-exit-after-first-frame` and `--desk-stats` exist.
tests: Headless test: one input makes one drain and one notify for the matching view and none for the others.

title: Contract tests, docs skeleton, cheat sheet, probe skeleton
done_when: The four one-product contracts of section 2 run in the desk job. The docs index links one stub page per topic. The cheat sheet shows compile-proven snippets for every kit item.
tests: The contract tests themselves; they start green because unfinished surfaces are listed as `Pending(slice-id)`.

title: Late: lead frame as JSON for native clients (needs lead-web S4)
done_when: `GET /frame.json?panels=...` returns the observer's frame (value, observed_at, cause, last_good, revision per panel) with the same access rules and masking as the page.
tests: The existing lead access tests cover the new route; a fixture frame round-trips.

title: Late: registry declarations for the verbs the panes call (needs kanban K2, K9)
done_when: Every verb a desktop pane runs is declared in the registry with `desk: Supported`. If `oxa.lead.hosts` has not landed, this PR lands that descriptor alone.
tests: The registry coverage contract turns the matching `Pending` rows into real ones.

title: Thread tree model
done_when: The visible rows are a flat list in the shared thread order with depth. `rows(range)` costs only the range. Collapsing hides descendants. The selection survives a re-index. A parent cycle cannot loop.
tests: Order equals `thread_order` for forks, workers, orphans and a cycle. Collapse and expand. Selection kept after an update.

title: Session index loader
done_when: The newest sessions arrive first, the rest follow in batches. A changed file updates one row with no full rescan. The loader thread ends when the index is complete.
tests: Batches arrive newest first. One appended file changes one row. No thread is left running.

title: Workers, subagents and forks under their parent
done_when: A parent with two workers and one subagent shows three children with kind, host, model, branch and state. State comes from `registry::state`. A corrupt registry file shows a notice on the parent and is never overwritten.
tests: The three-children case. A stopped worker. A corrupt registry file.

title: File watcher with no polling
done_when: An append to a watched file and a new file in a watched directory arrive as inputs. With no file activity the watcher thread stays blocked. Closing a thread removes its watch.
tests: Append and create are delivered once each. Unwatch stops delivery.

title: Transcript model on the shared reducer
done_when: Events and loaded entries become blocks only through `apply_event` and `blocks_from_entries`. The revision changes only when a row changed. A streaming delta touches the last row only. Row keys are stable.
tests: For every fixture the blocks equal the TUI reducer's. A delta changes one row.

title: Block rendering through the TUI views
done_when: A block becomes styled lines by calling `render_block` and parsing its SGR codes into spans (colour, bold, dim, italic, underline, strike, 256 and true colour, reset). Lines are cached per block and width; the cache is bounded.
tests: For every fixture the span text equals the `render_block` text without SGR codes. An unchanged block returns the cached lines.

title: Transcript tail loader and backward paging
done_when: Opening a session reads a bounded tail, not the file. Older pages load on request. A torn last line is skipped and read again when complete. The loader takes no lock and writes nothing.
tests: A large file is opened with a bounded read. Paging reaches the first entry. A torn line.

title: TailLink: follow a session another process owns
done_when: Complete appended lines become `LinkEvent::Entries` once and in order. A truncated or replaced file gives a reset. `send` answers with a read-only error. `caps()` says not interactive.
tests: Appends in two steps. Truncation. `send` is refused.

title: SecretBuf: locked, zeroised, never printed
done_when: The buffer is one fixed allocation, locked in memory and excluded from core dumps where the OS allows; when locking fails it says so and still works. It is zero after `clear` and after drop. It has no Debug, Display or Clone. `push` returns false when full.
tests: Zero after clear, read from the same allocation. Push to capacity. A failed lock is reported, not fatal.

title: Ask queue
done_when: Requests that need an answer become asks, first in first out, one visible. A dismissed or dropped ask answers `None` or `Deny`, never consent. A timeout uses one deadline while the ask is visible, not a polling timer. A cancel dismisses exactly its ask. Requests without an answer (notify, status, widget, title) go through `DialogHost::handle`.
tests: Dismiss answers `None`. A cancel before and after the ask is shown. Two asks keep their order.

title: Perf counters
done_when: The store counts inputs, drains, notifies, frames and the bytes each transcript holds, and reports them as JSON for `--desk-stats`.
tests: The report holds the counts after a known sequence.

title: Thread tree view
done_when: Only the visible rows of a 5,000-row tree are built. Up, Down, Left, Right, Enter, Home and End work. Depth indents. Kind, state, host and PR show as chips. A click selects.
tests: Headless: built rows stay near the viewport size. Keys move the selection and send the actions. A text snapshot of the visible rows.

title: Transcript view
done_when: Only visible rows are laid out. The view stays at the bottom while text streams unless the user scrolled up. Reaching the top asks for an older page. A width change reports the new column count.
tests: Headless: stick to bottom, release on scroll, the older-page action, the width action.

title: Block and line rendering
done_when: A row renders its spans with the theme colours and attributes in the transcript font. A row is a pure function of its data: no state, no timer. The row's plain text can be copied.
tests: A text snapshot of each fixture row kind. Copy returns the plain text.

title: Secret sheet and secure field
done_when: Typed and pasted characters go only into `SecretBuf`: never a `String`, a GPUI text state, the clipboard, the accessibility value or IME candidate text. The field shows dots. Enter answers, Esc dismisses. The sheet names the host, the thread, the exact command, the pid and the tool. The transcript behind is inert while the sheet is open. There is no blink timer.
tests: Headless: type and Enter gives the bytes; Esc gives a dismiss; the rendered text tree and the view's Debug output do not contain a typed canary.

title: Platform guards for the secure field
done_when: On macOS secure event input is on while the field has focus and off on blur, close and panic (a drop guard). On Linux an X11 session gives a plain warning string for the sheet; Wayland gives none.
tests: The guard releases on drop. The X11 and Wayland detection from environment values.

title: Title bar and status bar
done_when: The title shows thread title, cwd and tokens. The status bar shows model, thinking, the guard label and the mode label taken from `StatusModel`, never re-worded.
tests: A text snapshot for a sandboxed, an unsandboxed and a yolo status.

title: Probe: process sampler
done_when: For a pid and a window the sampler reports CPU percent of one core, wakeups per second (voluntary context switches over all threads), RSS, PSS and thread count as JSON. On macOS it reports CPU and RSS from `ps` and marks wakeups as not measured.
tests: On Linux it measures its own sleeping and busy phases within a tolerance.

title: Probe: synthetic sessions
done_when: Writes N sessions (default 5,000) with parents, forks and worker children into a temporary agent directory, the same for the same seed; and a 30-thread set with transcripts of a given size.
tests: The generated store lists N threads and nests the children.

title: Open, follow and keep transcripts
done_when: Selecting a thread loads its tail and follows it live. At most `oxa.desk.keepTranscripts` transcripts stay loaded; the oldest unpinned one is dropped and reloads on demand. A thread with a pending ask is never dropped.
tests: Select, append, see the new row. The keep limit drops the oldest. A pending ask pins.

title: InProcessLink and the secret path end to end
done_when: A prompt goes in and events come out of a session built by `run_with` on its own thread. UI requests reach the ask queue. A secret typed into `SecretBuf` reaches the broker's reply and nothing else.
tests: A turn with the scripted engine. With the broker's test askpass window: the canary is absent from the session file, the notices, the store's Debug output and the perf report.

title: Worker cards in the parent transcript
done_when: A worker started by the thread shows as a card with name, host, model, state, PR and tokens; opening it shows the worker's transcript in place.
tests: A card per registry record. Open sends the select action.

title: Probe: twenty fake live workers
done_when: Starts the fake engine with slow streaming scripts and N (default 20) oxa children registered as workers of one parent, streaming for a given time.
tests: N session files grow at the same time and N children nest under the parent in the index.

title: Probe: gate runner
done_when: `oxa-desk-probe gate --out report.json` runs the scenarios of section 5, compares them with `gate.toml`, prints a table and exits 1 when a stop condition fails.
tests: The runner fails on a threshold it is given and passes on one it meets, with a stub target.

title: Release-candidate artifacts from CI [architect]
done_when: A dispatch builds release `oxa-desk` and `oxa-desk-probe` for Linux arm64, Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 and uploads them with checksums. Nothing is published.
tests: The uploaded Linux binary passes the headless smoke in the same run.

title: Hidden window: no draws, no timers
done_when: While the window is hidden or occluded, inputs still apply but no view is notified and no frame is requested. Showing the window repaints once. The age relabel timer runs once a minute and only while the window is visible and focused.
tests: Headless: hidden, 100 inputs, zero notifies; show, one repaint.

title: Live thread state in the tree
done_when: A row shows running, needs you, stalled, done or failed from facts oxa already records, with no polling.
tests: Each state from its fact.

title: Prototype gate: measure and decide [owner + architect]
done_when: The report holds the measured numbers for every row of section 5 and the decision: continue with GPUI, or switch to Slint.
tests: None. The numbers are the evidence.

title: Compose model
done_when: Enter sends a prompt when idle and steers during a run; Alt+Enter queues a follow-up; `!cmd` and `!!cmd` become `UserBash`. Drafts are kept per thread. Queued messages can be taken back into the draft.
tests: Each key rule gives the right command. The draft survives a thread switch.

title: Compose view and multi-line editor
done_when: A multi-line editor with paste, undo, and a `/` completion list from the session's commands. Enter and Alt+Enter follow the compose model.
tests: Headless: type and Enter sends Submit; `/mo` offers `/model`; Alt+Enter queues.

title: Slash commands through the shared dispatcher
done_when: `Action::Slash` builds a `SlashCx` from the thread and calls `dispatch_slash`. Templates, skills and extension commands are sent as a prompt, as in the TUI. The desktop holds no command list.
tests: Every name in `INTERACTIVE_COMMANDS` gives the same `AppAction` kind as in the TUI test.

title: AppAction executor
done_when: Every `AppAction` variant has one outcome: a link command, a picker, a notice, an effect from `effects.rs`, a clipboard request, or a notice that the action needs a terminal. The match has no wildcard arm.
tests: Saving a setting writes the same file as the TUI path. An unsupported action gives its notice.

title: InProcessLink: the whole session command set
done_when: Compact, goal, navigate, fork, clone, model, thinking, mode, name, export, reload, reopen and shutdown work. Rebind, reopened, tree, unsent prompt and limit exit are handled as the TUI handles them. Abort and abort-retry go through the handle.
tests: Switch session and keep the queue rule (queued input for the old session is handed back, not sent). Abort ends a run.

title: Ask sheets
done_when: Confirm, select, input, editor, access, dangerous command and publication approval show as sheets. Labels come from the shared functions. Publication approval shows the exact body, focuses Deny and has no timeout.
tests: Headless: each kind answers what was chosen; Esc never consents.

title: Palette model
done_when: One query ranks registry commands, session commands, threads, settings, models, hosts and panes. An entry resolves to one `Action`.
tests: Every registry entry with `desk: Supported` is found by its path and resolves to `Action::Command` with its id.

title: Palette view (Ctrl K)
done_when: Ctrl K opens an overlay with a virtual result list. A command with required arguments asks for them, named as the registry names them. Help text is the registry summary.
tests: Headless: open, type, Enter sends the action; a required argument is asked for.

title: CliPort: run registry commands
done_when: A registry command runs in process on a background thread through `oxa_cli::run` with captured, bounded output and comes back as an input. A command that needs a terminal answers with its reason.
tests: `help` and `status --json` return their output. A tty-only command is refused with the reason.

title: Picker models
done_when: Model, scoped models, thinking, mode, theme, sessions, MCP and hotkeys pickers get their rows from the selector functions and return an `AppAction`.
tests: Each kind lists rows and returns the same action as the TUI selector.

title: Picker overlay
done_when: One overlay shows any picker with search, keys and a preview where the selector has one (theme).
tests: Headless: filter, pick, the action is sent.

title: Session lifecycle: new, resume, fork, clone, take over
done_when: New, resume, fork and clone open a thread with an InProcessLink. A followed thread can be taken over when no other process holds its lock; otherwise the view says who holds it.
tests: Fork creates a child under its parent. Take over is refused while the lock is held.

title: Tree navigator and fork point
done_when: `/tree` and `/fork` show the session tree from the shared selector data and send navigate or fork.
tests: Headless: pick a node, the navigate command is sent.

title: Key bindings from the keymap
done_when: Every binding the desktop uses comes from the keymap, so an owner rebind applies to both front ends.
tests: A rebind in settings changes the desktop binding.

title: Images: attach and show
done_when: Paste or drop attaches an image to the draft. Image blocks decode when visible and stay in a bounded cache.
tests: An attached image becomes a part of the prompt. An image off screen is not decoded.

title: Transcript tools: expand, hide thinking, copy, find
done_when: Tool rows expand and collapse, thinking can be hidden, a block can be copied, and find walks matches with the shared search.
tests: Find gives the same matches as the TUI search for a fixture.

title: Settings model from the descriptors
done_when: Every visible descriptor is one row with label, help, shown value, source, default, range and when it applies. An edit goes through `parse_input` and `check` and is saved by the shared effect. A user-only key cannot be saved to the project file. A secret row is masked.
tests: A value typed for each control kind is parsed, checked and saved as the TUI saves it. A user-only key refuses the project scope.

title: Settings view
done_when: One searchable, virtual list grouped by `Group`, with the group's own title and summary.
tests: Headless: search narrows the list; a group heading shows its summary.

title: Settings row editors
done_when: Each `Control` variant has an editor. The match has no wildcard arm, so a new control kind fails the build until it has an editor.
tests: Headless: one edit per editor sends the save action.

title: Cloud keys through the secret sheet
done_when: A key is typed into the secure field and handed to the existing store command through its stdin. The desktop writes no secrets file itself and shows only 'key present'.
tests: The canary key is absent from the store's Debug output, notices and settings rows; the command received it.

title: Usage model
done_when: The usage panel holds the pools of the JSON contract with value, time and cause. It refreshes when the usage log changes, not on a timer.
tests: A fixture report fills the panel. A failed read keeps the last good value with a cause.

title: Usage view
done_when: Pools show used, limit and reset as the contract gives them. No limit or price is built in.
tests: A text snapshot for a filled and a stale panel.

title: Models model
done_when: The list of local and cloud models comes from the command. The desktop has no model list of its own.
tests: A fixture list fills the panel; an unknown field is kept, not dropped.

title: Models view
done_when: Models list with state; picking one sets the thread's model.
tests: Headless: pick sends the model action.

title: LAN share model
done_when: Share state, keys and today's requests come from the share commands. Start, stop and key actions run the registry commands.
tests: A fixture status fills the panel. Stop sends the command.

title: LAN share view
done_when: Shows on or off, where it listens, guests and keys, with the start, stop and key actions.
tests: A text snapshot for on and off.

title: Workers by host model
done_when: Workers group by host with state, job, model and PR. Follow-up and stop run the registry commands.
tests: Grouping for two hosts. A follow-up sends the command.

title: Workers view
done_when: Workers by host with state chips; a row opens the worker's thread.
tests: Headless: open sends the select action.

title: Glance pane
done_when: The right column shows board counts per column, workers by host, usage and share in a few rows each. A heading opens the full pane. A stale panel shows its age and cause, never a blank.
tests: A text snapshot with one stale panel.

title: Theme: follow oxa and the desktop
done_when: The window uses the oxa theme and follows a theme change of the desktop through a file watch.
tests: A changed theme file changes the tokens.

title: Window and pane state
done_when: Window size, pane widths and the last thread are restored at start from a private (0600) state file.
tests: Saved state is restored. The file mode is 0600.

title: Host list and connection state
done_when: Hosts come from the same setting the dispatcher uses. Each has a state (connected, connecting, down with a cause) and a latency.
tests: State changes from host inputs. A host removed from settings disappears.

title: SSH transport
done_when: A host link runs ssh in batch mode with reader threads that block. A down host is retried on a user action or with a capped back-off while the window is visible. One-shot commands implement `CliPort` for a remote host.
tests: With a fake ssh program: lines arrive as inputs; exit gives 'down' with the cause; a one-shot command returns its output.

title: RpcLink
done_when: A session on another host is driven with RPC commands and shows the same transcript as a local one. Permission questions become asks. A secret ask is answered `None`: remote sudo stays refused.
tests: A recorded RPC exchange gives the same blocks as the same events in process. A secret request is refused.

title: Lead serve client
done_when: The client reads the frame once and then blocks on the live route; a `frame` event fetches only the changed panels. The bearer is never put in a URL or a log.
tests: With a local test server: a revision change fetches one panel. The token is absent from Debug output.

title: Lead model: asks, goal, alarms
done_when: Open asks, approvals, the goal and alarms are panels. Answering an ask or an approval runs the registry command or the lead route.
tests: A fixture frame fills the panels. An answer sends the command.

title: Lead view
done_when: Lead is a pinned thread with its open asks as children; an ask can be answered in place; chat with the lead is a normal thread.
tests: Headless: an ask row answers and collapses.

title: Board model
done_when: Seven columns of cards from the JSON contract. A move, add or edit runs the board command and waits for the new revision.
tests: A fixture board fills the columns. A move sends the operation.

title: Board view
done_when: Seven columns with virtual card lists, keys to move a card, counts in the headings.
tests: Headless: only visible cards are built; a key move sends the action.

title: Board item sheet
done_when: A card opens a sheet with its facts, its PR state and a link to its thread.
tests: A text snapshot of a running and a stuck item.

title: Remote threads in the tree
done_when: Threads of a connected host appear in the tree with the host name; workers on another host nest under their local parent.
tests: A remote list merges into the tree; a host going down keeps its rows marked stale.

title: Hosts bar
done_when: Host chips with state and latency in the title bar; a chip filters the tree.
tests: A text snapshot with one host down.

title: Split view
done_when: Two threads side by side, each with its own compose box; the focus keys come from the keymap.
tests: Headless: split, focus moves, close.

title: Open a remote worker in place
done_when: Opening a worker that runs on another host shows its transcript through that host's link.
tests: The right host link is chosen from the record.

title: `oxa desk` launcher
done_when: `oxa desk [args]` starts the `oxa-desk` binary found beside `oxa`, and says how to install it when it is missing. It stays unreachable until F10 sets the registry entry to Supported.
tests: With a stand-in binary the launcher starts it with the arguments. A missing binary gives the install hint.

title: Release build for Linux arm64 and x86_64 [architect]
done_when: The release build makes `oxa-desk` for both Linux targets as its own artifact with SBOM and checksums and passes the no-Python proof. It is not attached to a release yet.
tests: The artifact starts under the headless smoke in the release-build run.

title: macOS arm64 bundle [architect]
done_when: The macOS build stages an `oxa-desk` app bundle for arm64.
tests: The macOS job builds the bundle and runs `oxa-desk --version`.

title: Arch package and desktop entry
done_when: The package installs `oxa-desk`, a desktop entry and an SVG icon; removal is clean.
tests: The existing namcap, install and removal jobs.

title: Perf budget in CI [architect]
done_when: Every desk run records binary size, time to first frame and idle wakeups under the headless compositor and fails on the CI thresholds of gate.toml.
tests: The step fails on a threshold it is given in a dry run.

title: IME and keyboard-only use
done_when: Composed input works in the editor. Every action is reachable from the keyboard and focus is always visible. The secure field takes no composed text.
tests: Headless: a composed string is committed once. The secure field ignores preedit text.

title: User docs and security notes
done_when: The desktop page says what it is, how to start it and what the budget is. The security pages say what the secret field protects and what it does not.
tests: The documentation links check.

title: One version, one update notice
done_when: The window shows the suite's own update notice from the status contract. The desktop has no version check of its own.
tests: A fixture status with an update shows the notice.

title: Panic containment
done_when: A panic in a view or a session thread becomes an error row or a notice; the window and the other threads go on.
tests: A view that panics in the test leaves the window alive.

title: Final: ship the desktop [architect]
done_when: The registry entry `Desk` is Supported, the release attaches the desktop artifacts, and the install page names them. This is the first PR that changes what users get.
tests: The registry coverage contract has no `Pending` row left.
